description: Registered CCCP-26959; retained at Baikonur after withdrawal and placed in the courtyard of the Palace of Pioneers in the early 1980s standing on its own gear with free access; moved in 2005 to a purpose-built plinth at the north end of Yangel Street after years without maintenance; commemorates the Li-2's role as the workhorse of transport aviation during the construction of the cosmodrome
